subject.title: fix(groq): keep default Llama agent turns within TPM limit

question: Should every implicit `groq/llama-3.3-70b-versatile` request be capped at 1,024 output tokens, or should that cap apply only to the matched TPM-limit recovery attempt?
rationale: The base-tier failure needs a fix, but accepting shorter implicit responses for higher-limit Groq organizations is a user-visible provider policy decision rather than a necessary consequence of the bug fix.

options.title: Cap only recovery
options.body: Keep the existing first-attempt output behavior and apply 1,024 tokens only to the exact matched tool-free retry.

options.title: Approve global cap
options.body: Accept shorter implicit outputs for every user of the default Groq model and document the compatibility change.

recommendation.title: Cap only recovery
recommendation.body: Keep the existing first-attempt output behavior and apply 1,024 tokens only to the exact matched tool-free retry.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current Groq provider entrypoint and default-model registration affected by this decision.
